description: For a well-founded relation on a set-sized carrier, the collapse has transitive image and preserves relation edges.
signature:
Lemmatheca.SetTheory.MostowskiCollapse.collapse_image.{u, v} {α : Type v} [Small.{u, v} α] {R : α → α → Prop}
  (h : WellFounded R) :
  (ZFSet.range (Lemmatheca.SetTheory.MostowskiCollapse.collapse h)).IsTransitive ∧
    ∀ (a b : α),
      R a b → Lemmatheca.SetTheory.MostowskiCollapse.collapse h a ∈ Lemmatheca.SetTheory.MostowskiCollapse.collapse h b
